QuestInfo.name: On Memory Lane 1
QuestInfo.0: Temple Keeper, guardian of the Temple of Time has something to ask you. Go see Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: Temple Keeper requests that you mercifully put down #r#o2600701##k and #r#o2600702##k who had been wandering #b#MDmirrorD_328_0_##k after losing their minds from being sealed away by the goddess.
QuestInfo.2: You have made it so that  #o2600701# and #o2600702# will no longer wander aimlessly as Temple Keeper has requested.

0.0: Goodness... You really do resemble the Goddess. And yes, I'm aware that being the successor of the Transcendent isn't the same thing as being the child of Goddess. She created you, but she's not your mother.
0.1: Perhaps you can do something for me. I mean, as the Goddess's successor, this task is essentially your duty, but I won't force you to do it. Will you carry out your duty?

yes.0: After the Goddess was sealed, everything in the Temple of Time went mad. The beasts can't be tamed or restrained. They're nothing but monsters. And since they're the Goddess's creations, it's your duty to put an end to them.
yes.1: Could you take care of the #r#o2600701##k and #r#o2600702##k monsters in #b#MDmirrorD_328_0_##k? Only you can put them to rest.

1.0: You did the right thing. Don't be too disheartened...you did them a favor by saving them from eternal wandering.

default.0: Please put #r#o2600701##k and #r#o2600702##k being in #b#MDmirrorD_328_0_##k to rest.
